description:
Seldom does an opportunity of this magnitude present itself. Nestled on one of Rosedale’s most prestigious streets, this grand three-storey Georgian Revival residence occupies a rare and generous 50 x 150-foot lot, offering both privacy and expansive outdoor living. Steeped in history and character, this extraordinary home was designed by and originally belonged to renowned architect Beaumont Jarvis, a fact that imbues every corner with timeless elegance and architectural significance. Its remarkable character and cinematic beauty have also made it a sought-after filming location, featured in acclaimed television productions including Suits and 12 Monkeys.

From the moment you approach the property, the distinctive Dutch Gambrel roof and stately façade announce a home of unparalleled presence. Inside, every room has been lovingly and meticulously restored to preserve its original charm while seamlessly accommodating modern living. The residence showcases extraordinary period details throughout, including soaring 4 x 16-foot beams, leaded and stained glass windows, and finely crafted mouldings. These elements combine to create a sense of grandeur and refinement that is increasingly rare in today’s market. Modern updates include a chef's kitchen with a French imported Lacanche range and Gaggenau fridge and freezer.

The principal rooms are impressive in scale and proportion, designed to host both grand entertaining and intimate family gatherings. Two staircases, formal and informal, connect the home’s three levels, reflecting a thoughtful layout that balances elegance and functionality. The heart of the home opens to a rear mudroom that leads directly to breathtaking, mature gardens. Here, the oversized backyard offers a private oasis for outdoor entertaining, alfresco dining, and even wintertime recreation—a true ice rink under the stars.

This four-bedroom, three-bathroom residence accommodates families of every size with ease and sophistication. Each bedroom is spacious and filled with natural light, offering serene retreats within the home’s storied walls. The bathrooms, like the rest of the house, combine classic detailing with modern conveniences, ensuring comfort and luxury at every turn.

Beyond its architectural allure, the location of this home is simply unmatched. Just steps from the subway, the property offers seamless access to downtown Toronto while maintaining a serene, private ambiance. Ample parking with full garage. The surrounding neighborhood is celebrated for its family-friendly environment and access to some of the province’s top schools, making this an ideal setting for both lifestyle and investment.

One of the original poured concrete homes, this residence boasts exceptional durability, standing the test of time with unmatched structural integrity. Yet it is the combination of history, craftsmanship, and modern functionality that truly sets this property apart—a rare gem in one of Toronto’s most desirable enclaves.

Whether you are drawn to its historical significance, its remarkable period details, or its capacity for modern living, this Nanton Avenue treasure represents a singular opportunity to own a piece of Rosedale’s architectural heritage. From elegant formal rooms to intimate garden spaces, from its grand scale to the finest details, every aspect of this home reflects a lifestyle of sophistication, comfort, and enduring beauty.

Do not miss the chance to make this exceptional property your own—an opportunity like this in Rosedale is exceedingly rare.

address: 4426, avenue Christophe Colomb, Le Plateau-Mont-Royal, QC
description: Magnificent residence on two floors, bright and generously proportioned, located in a lively and warm neighborhood, known for its friendly neighborhood and its lively alley atmosphere. The property offers a spacious and upscale kitchen, equipped with a Viking gas stove - the dream of any serious cook - as well as heated floors ensuring absolute comfort in all seasons. The main living area is vast, warm and perfectly suited to both receptions and daily life . The house includes numerous rooms, ideal for a family, teleworking or guests, as well as two complete, well-thought-out and functional bathrooms, and a powder room on the ground floor. Outside, you will enjoy a pretty landscaped garden offering great privacy, a garage with socket (NEMA) to connect an electric vehicle charging station and a shed for bicycles and others; rare and highly sought after assets in a dense urban environment. Located on a peaceful and tree-lined street, the property is close to two of the most beautiful parks in the city (Lafontaine and Laurier), numerous quality food shops, and a few minutes from the Mont Royal metro station and the mountain. Everything is within a pleasant walking distance of McGill and UQAM universities as well as downtown, offering an exceptional urban lifestyle without compromising on space and comfort. In short: a house that ticks all the boxes and even the ones you didn't dare hope for!
